units.source: Creating a custom theme
units.context: Creating a custom theme

units.source: Step 1. Find a place to place the themes__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 1. Find a place to place the themes

units.source: Organization is an important aspect of managing a knowledge base. When developing a new theme or importing an existing one it's a good idea to keep them into one place.
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 1. Find a place to place the themes

units.source: As such, the first step is to create a new note to gather all the themes.
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 1. Find a place to place the themes

units.source: Step 2. Create the theme__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 2. Create the theme

units.source: Themes are code notes with a special attribute. Start by creating a new code note.
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 2. Create the theme

units.source: Then change the note type to a CSS code.
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 2. Create the theme

units.source: In the attributes of the note (the __TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__ button in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Status bar__TRILIUM_PH_3__), define the __TRILIUM_PH_4__ attribute to point to any desired name. This is the name that will show up in the appearance section in settings.
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 2. Create the theme

units.source: Step 3. Define the theme's CSS__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 3. Define the theme's CSS

units.source: As a very simple example we will change the background color of the launcher pane to a shade of blue.
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 3. Define the theme's CSS

units.source: To alter the different variables of the theme:
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 3. Define the theme's CSS

units.source: Step 4. Activating the theme__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 4. Activating the theme

units.source: Refresh the application (Ctrl+Shift+R is a good way to do so) and go to settings. You should see the newly created theme:
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 4. Activating the theme

units.source: Afterwards the application will refresh itself with the new theme:
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 4. Activating the theme

units.source: Do note that the theme will be based off of the legacy theme. To override that and base the theme on the Modern theme, see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Customize the Next theme__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 4. Activating the theme

units.source: Step 5. Making changes__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 5. Making changes

units.source: Simply go back to the note and change according to needs. To apply the changes to the current window, press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__R__TRILIUM_PH_5__ to refresh.
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 5. Making changes

units.source: It's a good idea to keep two windows, one for editing and the other one for previewing the changes.
units.context: Creating a custom theme > Step 5. Making changes
